remarks: Large one bedroom condo apartment located on the first floor of the building. This apartment is in excellent condition and features laminate floors, lots of closets and storage space, and a full bath with tub and shower. The galley-style kitchen has a gas range, microwave, dishwasher and plenty of counter-top and cabinet space, plus a large pantry. You'll also enjoy the roomy screen porch. Gas, heat, water, hot water and sewer are all included in the rent. The laundry room is located on the same floor as the unit. Reserved parking space #45 on left side of building is included.
